caption: The drawing depicts an object resembling a spoon or ladle with an elongated, curved handle that terminates in a carved human head. The main object is rendered in shades of brown and tan, giving it a wooden or possibly ivory appearance. The bowl of the spoon is wide and shallow, with subtle shading to suggest depth. The handle arches upward and then sharply curves downward, ending in a detailed sculpted head featuring a headdress or cap and facial details such as eyes, nose, and mouth. To the right of the main object, there is an inset drawing that provides a close-up view of the head at the end of the handle, emphasizing its carved features, including geometric details on the head covering and a row of dots along the neck. The background of the drawing is a plain beige color, and both the main object and the inset are contained within outlined rectangular borders.
title: Ladle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
